components.name: Navigation link
components.description: Shared navigation with current-page and hover underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans),serif; font-size:1rem; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav:hover,.ds-nav[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--primary); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.45em; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Content link
components.description: Underlined destination link used beneath reading sections.
components.css: .ds-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--primary); font-family:var(--font-sans),serif; font-size:1.125rem; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.25em; text-decoration-thickness:1px; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Menu
components.html: <button class="ds-menu" type="button" aria-expanded="false">Menu<svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none"><path d="M2 5h12M2 11h12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-menu { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.65rem; min-height:44px; padding:.5rem 0; border:0; background:none; color:var(--foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans),serif; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer; } .ds-menu:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:6px; }

components.name: Reading list row
components.description: Text-only content row; no hover or action styling.
components.css: .ds-row { padding-block:1rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans),serif; line-height:1.7; } .ds-row h3 { font-size:1.25rem; line-height:1.4; font-weight:500; margin:0 0 .55rem; }

components.name: Portrait reserve
components.description: Unadorned field while no portrait is supplied.
